results.title: Rafael Nadal career statistics - Wikipedia
results.content:
Nadal's 22 Grand Slam singles titles place him second in the men's all-time rankings, behind Djokovic's 24 titles. His 30 Grand Slam singles finals place him 3rd in the men's all-time rankings, behind Djokovic's 37 and Federer's 31 finals, respectively. He has won 14 French Open titles, an all-time record at any tournament. He was also the youngest player in the Open Era to win all four majors (24 years old) until his compatriot Carlos Alcaraz completed the feat at 22 years old in 2026. results.title: Rafael Nadal | Biography, Olympics, Titles, & Facts
results.content:
Rafael Nadal is a Spanish tennis player who began his professional career in 2001. By 2005, Nadal was among the top players in the world. Nadal is especially known for his play on clay, where he has dominated. He has won a record 14 French Open championships. Nadal also holds 22 Grand Slam men’s singles titles. He began playing tennis at age four.
